objective: Prove: for n >= 3 and m >= 2 every n x m torus of equally spaced rings has a half-turn at every contact, so every contact persists; inserting one band into a loop of n rings, each new ring joined to its partner on both sides, gives the n x 2 torus; so from a loop the band law makes the torus at its first step and keeps every contact persistent at every stage.
status: Proved 2026-11-08 (by hand; finite claims checked exactly): every n x m torus of equally spaced rings with n >= 3, m >= 2 has a half-turn at every contact, so every contact persists; one band inserted into a loop of n rings, each new ring joined to its partner on both sides, gives the n x 2 torus, so from a loop the band law makes the torus at its first step and keeps every contact persistent at every stage.
title: One band makes the torus
